title: Numerical sector area, 3 significant figures
source: Theory P1-4.3 Quick check 2 / Worked example 4.6a (sector of radius 6 cm, angle 1.2 rad, area 21.6 cm^2); book pp.107–108
stem: Find the area of a sector of radius \({r|int}\,\mathrm{cm}\) and angle \({th|raw}\) radians, correct to 3 significant figures.

steps.name: Sm
steps.note: Use (1/2) r^2 theta with theta in radians.

steps.name: S
steps.note: Correct to 3 significant figures, including significant trailing zeros.

contexts.stem: A slice of a circle of radius \({r|int}\,\mathrm{cm}\) has angle \({th|raw}\) radians at the centre. Find the area of this sector, correct to 3 significant figures.
A sector of a circular plate has radius \({r|int}\,\mathrm{cm}\) and angle \({th|raw}\) radians. Find its area, correct to 3 significant figures.

title: Perimeter of a sector in terms of r and A

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2019). Official MS (4 marks): M1 uses A=1/2 r^2 theta; A1 theta=2A/r^2; B1 P=r+r+r theta; A1 correct simplified P=2r+2A/r. The answer is symbolic, so the part is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 9709/11/M/J/19 Question 3, taken from the official QP.

A sector of a circle of radius \(r\,\mathrm{cm}\) has an area of \(A\,\mathrm{cm}^2\). Express the perimeter of the sector in terms of \(r\) and \(A\).

steps.name: A
steps.note: MS: A1, correct simplified expression for P. Official answer: 2r + 2A/r.
